events.verdict: Cunningham (DET) and Brown (BOS) mutually engage and disengage with one another during the rebound.
Duren (DET) is moving forward slightly prior to marginal body contact occurring with Tatum (BOS) as he gathers the ball.
Horford (BOS) establishes a screening position in Harris' (DET) path and re-establishes backward slightly as he is absorbing the initial contact, which he does not deliver illegally.
Duren (DET) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds. Possession correctly remains with Boston.
Harris (DET) and White (BOS) engage and disengage with one another as they approach the screen near the wing.
Holiday (BOS) is shuffling backward in Ivey's (DET) path and absorbs the incidental body contact to his chest before cleanly dislodging the ball away.
Holiday (BOS) makes contact with the ball and the part of Harris' (DET) right hand that is on the ball, cleanly dislodging it away during Harris' upward shooting motion.
Hardaway Jr. (DET) initiates contact with Tatum's (BOS) right arm prior to the release of the jump shot attempt.
White (BOS) cleanly blocks Cunningham's (DET) shot attempt near the rim.
White (BOS) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds. Possession correctly remains with Detroit.
Tatum (BOS) legally contests Ivey's (DET) jump shot attempt and would avoid Ivey if Ivey did not slightly extend his right foot toward Tatum to initiate the marginal contact after the release.
Cunningham (DET) attempts to bring his left hand to the ball and marginal contact occurs with White's (BOS) left arm and side as he dribbles inside the perimeter.
Duren (DET) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Tatum's (BOS) left arm is placed across Ivey's (DET) left side and arm, restricting his SQBR.  The contact occurs prior to the ball deflection.
Ivey (DET) commits a take foul on White (BOS).
Holiday (BOS) commits a take foul on Cunningham (DET).
Harris (DET) commits a take foul on Brown (BOS).
Brown (BOS) legally contests Beasley's (DET) jump shot attempt.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Beasley (DET) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Boston.
Harris (DET) commits a take foul on Tatum (BOS).
